parent is a P212 proof/source contributor and cannot supply this source's
independent review. No scientific or manuscript acceptance is requested here.

## Outcome and exact boundary

This is a new, incompatible S0/contract01 evidence interface. It does not
relax an old parser in place. It proposes exactly `/usr/bin/kpsewhich --help`
and then `/usr/bin/kpsewhich --version`, as two separately gated direct
foreground product calls. It replaces the selected Python ctypes/subreaper
and Node/preload/driver nesting for these two roles only. All old programs,
frontiers, failures, consumed grants, receipts and strict obligations remain.

The three complete new sources are:

| Source | Only job |
| --- | --- |
| capture.js | One selected help OR version product call; retain every actual exec/poll return; no file read, raw hash, next call or seal. |
| file_keys.mjs | Root's finite physical-leaf whole-file key reader and four explicit directory point observations; no child, maps, imports of received programs, alias following or discovery. |
| receive.mjs | Receive supplied canonical JSON/raw-byte records as data; check exact bindings, keys, streams and native frame consistency; no filesystem or tool calls, automatic receipt acceptance or option interpretation. |

Every exported operational function has its own unconditional
`SOURCE_ENABLED = false` check. There is no CLI/automatic invocation.
The two .mjs files have ordinary builtin imports, so even importing a disabled
file is an unauthorized source execution, not a safe refusal test. An enabled
copy needs an actual complete new-source delta and independent reception.
Filling any disabled JSON cannot activate the supplied sources. This packet
contains neither an enabled copy nor an operational grant.

## New trust/key claims; old claims explicitly unsatisfied

Ordinary product, kernel/filesystem, root key-tool Node/builtin bootstrap,
and unscanned namespace ancestors are trusted. The key utility is not keyed
by another runtime observer merely to authorize its own observation. Root
still receives its exact source bytes/entry request as documentary inputs.
That trust does not assert which Node runtime images loaded and is not a
transplanted P213 69-file observation. The data-only receiver likewise uses
ordinary trusted root Node/crypto; no received program is imported by it.

The actual direct tools remain measured inputs, not part of an undefined
trusted blob: complete Bash/env/kpsewhich bytes, applicable loader/library,
configuration/locale/search dependencies, source/receipt files and the
empty-input bytes require a finite source-justified before/after key. The
source-gated observation proposal and remaining installed-closure blockers
are in DEPENDENCY_GATE.md. Unknown relevant dependencies remain HOLD.

The new file fields are exactly dev, ino, mode, nlink, uid, gid, rdev, size,
mtimeNs and ctimeNs, as actual decimal integer strings. A regular leaf gets
lstat before; O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK open; same-fd fstat checked
against the expected key before any byte; full ordered bytes through EOF;
same-fd fstat after; lexical lstat after; successful close. All ten fields
agree within a successful file row. Every retained byte is reconstructed
from exact hex and SHA-256 checked by the data receiver. There is no atime,
block-size/block-count or birthtime field and no statx/mask/ABI attestation.
This never satisfies the old fourteen-field/native-0xFFF requirement.

The reader permits no leaf symlink, even for optional files; a surprise
alias/nonregular leaf stops before content open. Ancestor traversal is
trusted, not recursively scanned or claimed physical. Optional absence is
only the exact allowed leaf's actual lstat ENOENT; ENOTDIR/permission errors
are not absence. Separate before/after observations are required for absence.
There is no automatic readlink, alias target read, sibling expansion or
configuration include traversal. A separately reviewed finite amendment
must handle any necessary alias; no slash-root or CUDA-chain chase occurs.

This new key utility is finite, not hard real-time: at most 96 file entries,
128 MiB per file and 256 MiB total accepted bytes. It records one possible
overflow sentinel and partial failure, then stops. No timeout can guarantee
regular filesystem calls return. Closing/transport/allocation errors remain
failed or incomplete evidence, never invented full outputs. Source-gate
first observations may lack an expected key; pre/post operational keys may
not. Raw first-content observations need a prior direct-settlement receipt.

## Exact launch, stdin and raw ownership

The entire prepared command strings are in REQUEST.disabled.json. Product
request fields are cmd, workdir, shell=/bin/bash, login=false, tty=false,
yield_time_ms=1000 and max_output_tokens=4000. The cwd is the independently
received empty `qa/p212_build_dependency_query01/query_cwd`.

Only shell builtins select a child-local 077 umask and noclobber, open the
three standard descriptors, and `exec` the absolute `/usr/bin/env -i`.
That executable replaces itself with absolute `/usr/bin/kpsewhich` and one
literal flag. There is no pipeline, background task, shell expansion of an
argument, helper interpreter, kpsewhich PATH search or third tool vector.
The child receives exactly PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, LANG=C.UTF-8,
LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, TZ=UTC, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1788825600,
FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1, openin_any=p, openout_any=p. No HOME is set/inherited
by the env child. Bash/env's earlier inherited startup is unmeasured; ENV8
does not retrospectively clear their loader or shell startup effects.

Stdin is the selected `qa/p212_keyed_stdin_input01/empty.stdin` regular leaf,
with independently received complete empty SHA-256 key before and after
each call. Bash freshly opens that spelling; ordinary open semantics supply
the initial offset-zero inference. This is NOT the old same-open-fd
fourteen-field check/one-byte EOF read/handoff performed by outer and driver.
No fd0 metadata is observed here; no null-device equivalence, physical
ancestor-chain proof or continuous path-race exclusion is asserted. The
trusted fresh shell open of the independently keyed empty leaf is the exact
new input policy; a source/policy reviewer must decide whether to accept it.

Root must separately create and receive the new 0700 raw parent and its
help01/version01 children, with empty stage directories and exact owned uid.
The proposed reader inspects only the query cwd and these three literal
directories, including complete EOF name lists (at most two expected names).
Directory handle identity is not observed: lexical before/after identity
plus ordinary trusted opendir is the stated limit. Only the planned
stdout.raw/stderr.raw additions are allowed. Noclobber's safety argument
depends on this fresh owned directory, not on arbitrary preexisting targets.
No directory is created or inspected by this packet.

The shell assigns fd1 and fd2 to two separate exclusive raw files before
executing env/kpsewhich. Product `output` is a separate control channel;
it must remain actually empty for successful collection. It is never split
or relabelled as the tool's two raw streams. If redirection/exec fails, the
actual product return and any partial files are retained; a nonzero exit
does not identify a successful kpsewhich startup. Even exit0 is conditional
on the independently received source/binary execution correspondence.

## Direct lifetime, raw intake and staged two-call graph

The collector submits one real exec_command and follows only its actually
returned session with empty write_stdin polls. It records full returned
objects without a lossy JSON copy. Unknown fields, invalid/mismatched
handles, mixed exit/session state, nonempty control output, throws or
nonzero exit stop. Available raw returned fields remain in frames even if
condensed status fields could not be accepted. A JavaScript catch records
normalized name/message, not the complete original exception object.

At most 121 actual returns are collected, with a 120-second budget checked
between returned calls. It is not a hard interruption deadline. The product
may yield to the enclosing functions cell; root separately preserves every
actual functions request/yield/cell/wait/final original. No guessed PID,
session, end time, final envelope or replay-produced replacement is allowed.

An immediate genuine final product exit needs no fabricated native PID.
It is evidence that the ordinary trusted product completed its direct
command. A yielded session needs the same actual session's final completion.
This is NOT the old inner detached-PGID, outer subreaper adoption/waitpid,
task/children census or wider owned-descendant settlement observation.
Direct native PID is explicitly NOT_EXPOSED_BY_PRODUCT. No whole-host,
historical/continuous spawn, escaped writer or malicious external writer
exclusion is claimed. If actual source/loader/constructor behavior could
spawn or retain an unowned writer, direct completion is insufficient and
raw finalization stays HOLD; the finite installed-source gate must resolve
that concern rather than merely assume all programs are no-spawn.

The root sequence, with no automatic edge, is:

1. Independent new source/policy acceptance; finite actual tool closure;
   separately prepared fresh owned directories and current input key.
2. Complete binding bytes plus a nonself binding key outside that binding;
   a separately recorded immediate preflight and consumed one-help grant.
3. Actual help product call. Any unknown handle requires a separately

   is performed by the collector.
4. Root receives genuine direct completion under the accepted no-unresolved-
   writer source boundary, then separately authorizes full same-fd raw reads.
   Receive both raw streams, post-key, exact directory delta, all product
   originals and the separate ten-field selected-binding after-key.
5. Root's actual accepted complete help receipt, fresh version preflight/key

6. Apply the same complete reception to version. A separate root installed-
   option/default/all/format/expansion/generator semantics decision is still
   necessary. Neither source output nor substring tests supply that decision.

The binding itself never contains its own pin or a future actual product
return. Its external reference is fixed in each actual selection. The two
request templates do not depend on binding bytes. Actual binding bytes,
ten-field lexical/same-fd records and before/after agreement are distinct
nonself DQD-O1 evidence. Receipt pins are not self-authenticating reasoning;
the data receiver explicitly returns ROOT_ORIGINAL_AND_SEMANTIC_RECEPTION_PENDING.

## Why the proposed graph is smaller, conditionally

The new capture source uses product calls and shell builtins, followed by
absolute env/kpsewhich exec replacement. It has no Python, ctypes, Node child,
subreaper, preload, module registry, scientific verifier or TeX build process.
Python-specific import/cache/probe rows and Node-specific probe/package-type
rows therefore have no program role in this proposed direct tool process.
The separately trusted root key/data tools are disclosed, not recursively
observed. Removing an unused interpreter does NOT prove that a library it
formerly used is absent from the new tool's independent native graph.

The current upstream kpsewhich source places help/version exits inside
command-line processing before the subsequent program-name/init_more and
lookup work. This supports a prospective help/version-only gate, not
installed binary/source equality. kpathsea_new, command parser support,
linked initializers, exit/stdio and error paths still need correspondence.
This packet does not claim their complete local closure from the upstream
file alone. [TeX Live primary source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TeX-Live/texlive-source/trunk/texk/kpathsea/kpsewhich.c).

The examined glibc loader uses binary path tags, environment search,
cache-selected paths and default search. Consequently a CUDA directory
can matter without GPU science if relevant resolution or preload selects
it. A saved CUDA directory identity is not evidence of that selection.
Raw ld.so.conf fragments describe configuration-production candidates;
omission from runtime input needs the actual loader/build semantics and
complete effective cache/selected-path evidence, not a name-based deletion.
[glibc 2.35 loader source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bminor/glibc/glibc-2.35/elf/dl-load.c).

the env child's variables does not make system preload or binary dynamic
tags disappear. Constructor/error/loading behavior therefore remains part
of the no-unresolved-writer and file dependency gate.
[glibc 2.35 runtime linker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bminor/glibc/glibc-2.35/elf/rtld.c).

The examined env implementation ultimately execs the selected program;
it does not need a Python/Node supervisor for this ordinary path. Its own
startup, locale, translated diagnostics and error branches still require
bounded source reasoning. [Coreutils 8.32 env source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreutils/coreutils/v8.32/src/env.c).
Reference tags are documentary comparison choices, NOT observed installed
versions. The attempted TeX Live 2022 tag, lib.c and Bash source/manual
fetches failed and supply no positive claim; failures are retained in the
primary-source request record. No source-to-binary correspondence is inferred.

The DATA interpretation gate has an explicit finite acceptance test:

1. Read ELF fields only from the captured complete bytes: class, byte order,

   executable formats, hidden/truncated tables or an unclassified loader
   mechanism. Decoder source must itself be received as DATA-only; it must
   not load, execute or resolve any string obtained from the ELF.
2. Produce a literal table with at most 32 distinct ELF image nodes, 96
   named file states and 64 initialization/finalization entries. Each edge
   records its origin body pin and byte span, literal needed/tag name,
   exact loader rule, candidate spellings and complete selected/candidate
   byte keys or actual optional-absence evidence. A returned pointer/address
   is not a proof of code behavior. Each init/fini entry is matched to a
   specific received package/source role; unsupported indirection, extra
   image/path/entry or an unresolved explicit child/load helper is HOLD.
   Do not respond to an exceeded bound with automatic recursion or a new probe.
3. For cache/default/path/hwcaps alternatives, either receive the exact
   applicable selector facts or key the complete finite possible set and
   label it a conservative set, not an observed loaded-map list. Resolve
   each needed leaf alias only under a separately named, bounded link-text
   observation; the supplied physical-leaf reader does not follow one.
   Relevant CUDA/cache path candidates are handled by the same rule.
4. For source semantics, receive an actual version/build/package record and
   the complete named app/initialization routines used in the argument,
   with exact spans and their finite configuration/locale/extra-load/child
   branches. Matching distributed binary bytes to a specific package is
   useful provenance, not a formally verified compiler theorem. A public
   upstream tag or embedded version string alone does not prove equality.
   No proof of all possible behavior of libc or of every instruction is
   claimed or demanded by this finite ordinary-trust policy.
